coverage_gaps: Deadlock Detection & Recovery is not covered by either final set. Gate Smashers' numbered series has no dedicated detection-and-recovery video at all (it jumps from avoidance/PYQ questions to Memory Management), and Jenny's Lec25/Lec26 (English) were left as runners-up to keep the English set at 4 videos focused on necessary conditions, RAG, handling-methods/prevention, and avoidance/Banker's algorithm. Detection & recovery is tested less frequently on GATE than RAG or Banker's algorithm, but students who need it should supplement with Jenny's Lec25 (Detection and Recovery: Wait-for Graph and Banker's algorithm) and Lec26 (Deadlock Recovery) in English; no equally strong dedicated Hinglish detection-and-recovery video from a top channel was found. Multi-instance RAG nuance (Gate Smashers L-4.3) is also left as a Hinglish runner-up rather than a required 5th video, since single-instance RAG (included) covers the core GATE scope item.
